summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests, and without committing. Files changed: src/textual/renderables/opacity.py (merge blended color into existing style so click metadata is kept), src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py (new clickable_ranges input before width; yields one Text; click spans appended last), src/textual/_layout_resolve.py (docstring only; Edge already had min_size), new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs), new docs/reference/tabs.md, tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/test_tabs.py. Judgment calls: bar position is kept in displayed-tab index space (differs from find_tab_by_name's full-list index only with duplicate names, to satisfy the underline-under-displayed-tab criterion); letter search only applies to single-character keys; the layout resolver is applied to padding edges only so zero-width labels are not treated as flexible; the sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Unverified: no tests were run, and the Opacity metadata preservation relies on rich's Style addition keeping meta, which I could not confirm from the installed source.
